{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcyupsqxNxx9PPLCmNoqv","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_016orTcbj59aU1jT2XdcJr6F","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 << 'EOF'\nimport csv, re, datetime\nfrom collections import Counter, defaultdict\n\nwith open('dataset/employees.csv') as f:\n    employees = list(csv.DictReader(f))\nwith open('dataset/tasks.csv') as f:\n    tasks = list(csv.DictReader(f))\nwith open('dataset/timesheet.csv') as f:\n    ts = list(csv.DictReader(f))\n\npay = {t['task_id']: int(t['pay_per_completion']) for t in tasks}\nfix_emp = {'15720759071':'75020759171','62020111425':'65020111422',\n           '16102016795':'96102016751','84731091580':'87031491580',\n           '68011910138':'68011810139'}\nemp_ids = {e['PESEL'] for e in employees}\n\n# PESEL checksum validation for both sets\ndef pesel_ok(p):\n    if len(p)!=11 or not p.isdigit(): return False\n    w=[1,3,7,9,1,3,7,9,1,3]\n    return (10-sum(int(a)*b for a,b in zip(p,w))%10)%10 == int(p[10])\nprint(\"employee PESELs failing checksum:\", [p for p in emp_ids if not pesel_ok(p)])\nprint(\"corrupted ids failing checksum:\", [p for p in fix_emp if not pesel_ok(p)])\n\n# billing periods: first Tuesday of each month\ndef first_tuesday(y,m):\n    d = datetime.date(y,m,1)\n    return d + datetime.timedelta(days=(1-d.weekday())%7)\nbounds = [first_tuesday(2025,m) for m in (3,4,5,6,7)]\nprint(\"period starts:\", bounds)\n\ndef fix_date(s):\n    y,m,d = map(int, s.split('-'))\n    # clamp day to last valid day of month\n    while True:\n        try: return datetime.date(y,m,d)\n        except ValueError: d -= 1\n\ndef period_of(d):\n    for i in range(4):\n        if bounds[i] <= d < bounds[i+1]: return i\n    return None\n\n# coverage per employee per period\ncov = defaultdict(Counter)\ntask_dups = 0\noutside = []\nfor r in ts:\n    eid = fix_emp.get(r['employee_id'], r['employee_id'])\n    d = fix_date(r['date'])\n    p = period_of(d)\n    if p is None: outside.append(r['date'])\n    else: cov[eid][p]+=1\n    tl = re.findall(r'\\d+', r['performed_tasks'])\n    if len(tl)!=len(set(tl)): task_dups+=1\nprint(\"dates outside periods:\", outside)\nprint(\"duplicate task in one list:\", task_dups)\nmissing = [(e, [p for p in range(4) if cov[e][p]==0]) for e in emp_ids if any(cov[e][p]==0 for p in range(4))]\nprint(\"employees missing a period:\", missing)\nprint(\"employees with records:\", len(cov), \"of\", len(emp_ids))\nprint(\"records per period:\", Counter(p for e in cov for p,c in cov[e].items() for _ in range(c)))\nEOF","description":"Validate PESEL checksums and billing-period coverage"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4110,"cache_read_input_tokens":30480,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":4110,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6a83e075-ee16-407c-8a8f-01cf72d58a7b","uuid":"6a756e17-b70a-4a2f-926b-1845b5710b87","request_id":"req_011Ccyups3aw6v9CjWeSwRHq"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011Ccyuw7pFhpsGsfXbz3zew","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01CTzMxoF74vkCgGVom5QZVU","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/answer.py","content":"\"\"\"Compute total monthly salaries per employee from the cleaning-service dataset.\n\nData cleaning applied:\n- 5 employee IDs in the timesheet fail the PESEL checksum; each is a 2-3 digit\n  typo of exactly one valid employee PESEL (next-closest is 7+ digits away),\n  so they are corrected to that PESEL.\n- performed_tasks lists with missing brackets are parsed by extracting the\n  numeric task IDs; task IDs absent from tasks.csv are dropped.\n- The bonus column equals the sum of task pays for 893/900 well-formed rows\n  (the rest are negative bonuses on empty task lists), so the bonus is\n  recomputed from the valid performed tasks.\n- The salary_amount column is inconsistent with hours*rate+bonus in 990/1008\n  rows and is ignored.\n- Impossible dates (2025-04-31, 2025-06-31) have their day clamped to the\n  last valid day of the month.\n\nBilling periods: the earliest record (2025-03-04) is a Tuesday, so each\nmonth's billing period starts on the first Tuesday of that calendar month\nand ends the day before the first Tuesday of the next month.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport datetime\nimport math\nimport re\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nDATA_DIR = \"/app/dataset\"\n\n\ndef pesel_valid(p: str) -> bool:\n    if len(p) != 11 or not p.isdigit():\n        return False\n    weights = [1, 3, 7, 9, 1, 3, 7, 9, 1, 3]\n    check = (10 - sum(int(a) * w for a, w in zip(p, weights)) % 10) % 10\n    return check == int(p[10])\n\n\ndef parse_date(s: str) -> datetime.date:\n    y, m, d = map(int, s.split(\"-\"))\n    while True:\n        try:\n            return datetime.date(y, m, d)\n        except ValueError:\n            d -= 1\n\n\ndef first_weekday_of_month(y: int, m: int, weekday: int) -> datetime.date:\n    d = datetime.date(y, m, 1)\n    return d + datetime.timedelta(days=(weekday - d.weekday()) % 7)\n\n\ndef answer() -> dict[str, list[int]]:\n    with open(f\"{DATA_DIR}/employees.csv\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        employees = list(csv.DictReader(f))\n    with open(f\"{DATA_DIR}/tasks.csv\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        tasks = list(csv.DictReader(f))\n    with open(f\"{DATA_DIR}/timesheet.csv\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        timesheet = list(csv.DictReader(f))\n\n    rate = {e[\"PESEL\"]: float(e[\"hourly_rate\"]) for e in employees}\n    task_pay = {t[\"task_id\"]: float(t[\"pay_per_completion\"]) for t in tasks}\n\n    def fix_employee_id(eid: str) -> str | None:\n        if eid in rate:\n            return eid\n        if not pesel_valid(eid):\n            candidates = sorted(\n                rate,\n                key=lambda p: sum(1 for a, b in zip(p, eid) if a != b),\n            )\n            best = candidates[0]\n            best_dist = sum(1 for a, b in zip(best, eid) if a != b)\n            second_dist = sum(1 for a, b in zip(candidates[1], eid) if a != b)\n            if best_dist <= 3 and second_dist > best_dist:\n                return best\n        return None\n\n    dates = [parse_date(r[\"date\"]) for r in timesheet]\n    start_weekday = min(dates).weekday()\n\n    def period_start(d: datetime.date) -> datetime.date:\n        start = first_weekday_of_month(d.year, d.month, start_weekday)\n        if d < start:\n            prev_y, prev_m = (d.year, d.month - 1) if d.month > 1 else (d.year - 1, 12)\n            start = first_weekday_of_month(prev_y, prev_m, start_weekday)\n        return start\n\n    totals: dict[str, dict[datetime.date, float]] = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(float))\n    for row, d in zip(timesheet, dates):\n        eid = fix_employee_id(row[\"employee_id\"])\n        if eid is None:\n            continue\n        try:\n            hours = float(row[\"hours_worked\"])\n        except ValueError:\n            continue\n        if hours < 0:\n            continue\n        task_ids = re.findall(r\"\\d+\", row[\"performed_tasks\"])\n        bonus = sum(task_pay[t] for t in task_ids if t in task_pay)\n        totals[eid][period_start(d)] += hours * rate[eid] + bonus\n\n    return {\n        eid: [\n            int(math.floor(v + 0.5))\n            for _, v in sorted(months.items())\n        ]\n        for eid, months in totals.items()\n    }\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6296,"cache_read_input_tokens":34590,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":6296,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6a83e075-ee16-407c-8a8f-01cf72d58a7b","uuid":"572f6a7c-5189-4d41-a80d-69d3d14049cf","request_id":"req_011Ccyuw6pEGXL21W1i5YuUZ"}
